نبذة

Gaye’s Hair Fashions has been the leading haircare provider in Ipswich since 1973 and the number one stop for all your hair requirements. With over 50 years of experience, they guarantee the highest of hairdressing standards. Our team of dedicated Stylists are passionate about what they do and love ensuring you walk out feeling fabulous. Our friendly staff are committed to ensuring you enjoy your time with them, whether it is a quick eyebrow wax or full colour and cut service. We are looking forward to seeing you in salon soon!
